name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €81/MWh on 18 Nov, above the €70 Alert line; Hormuz LNG route still under attack
state: Dutch TTF gas closed near €81/MWh on 18 Nov, 12% lower on the week but 23% higher over three months and well above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). Its largest daily fall of the past five sessions was 6.8%. Qatari LNG relies on the Strait of Hormuz, where an ADNOC vessel was attacked on 17 Nov (The National).
for_you: High wholesale gas prices feed into household energy bills and the Ofgem price cap with a lag.

sources.title: The National — Iran attacks Kuwait in widening escalation

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
